question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 58, 13, 74, 38, 98, 36, 43, 39 and 42 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let assumed mean be 40.

Deviations: +18, −27, +34, −2, +58, −4, +3, −1, +2

Net deviation sum = 81

Average deviation = 81 ÷ 9 = 9

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average Deviation = 40 + 9 = 49

**∴ Answer = 49**
